newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sixteen frozen illegal aliens surrender in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Sixteen frozen illegal aliens surrender in Germany.

text.p: Sixteen illegal immigrants gave themselves up to authorities in the east German town of Wildau after being caught unprepared by the severe cold.

Police said the 16, of whom four were under 18, turned up in an industrial park only lightly dressed, some of them barefoot. Some were suffering from badly frozen hands and feet and all were taken to hospital.
Fifteen of the immigrants said they were from Bangladesh and one said he was from Iraq.
Night temperatures have been dropping to around minus 15 degrees Celsius in some parts of the country in the current cold snap, and at least four people have died from the cold in the last week.
